experiment.topic: BTC-USD relative strength reversion to mean after 30-hour deviation exceeding 8%
experiment.hypothesis: When BTC-USD relative strength deviates from SPY by more than 8% over a 30-hour period, it will revert to the mean within the next 12 hours with a probability greater than 70%.

test.note: No misleading proxy: hypothesis requires unavailable inputs or rule expression.

experiment.falsification_test: If BTC-USD relative strength to SPY over a 30-hour lookback shows no statistically significant reversion to mean when deviation exceeds 8% for 3 consecutive hours, and this pattern persists across 2024-2026 market cycles, the hypothesis is falsified.
